experiences.description:
I developed and maintained user-facing features for a cross-platform desktop application using TypeScript, React, Next.js, and Node.js. My work covered product flows, settings, update behavior, internal communication, and core application logic.

I also worked on multimedia/export-related features and native desktop integrations for macOS and Windows. The role involved daily collaboration in English with an international stakeholder on product behavior, implementation details, and release-oriented improvements.

I built internal web and desktop tools using Next.js, Tailwind CSS, Flask, Python, and Tkinter to simplify operational workflows and reduce manual work in day-to-day processes. I implemented APIs, internal interfaces, and practical tools for a non-tech operational environment.

I also worked with SQL, pandas, and Matplotlib to make internal operational information easier to access through data processing, reporting, and queries. The role involved gathering requirements from different teams and translating business needs into usable software.

I build and improve personal projects to deepen my experience in full-stack development, product thinking, architecture, deployment, optimization, and testing. These projects include full-stack applications, desktop tools, APIs, authenticated flows, maps, database-backed systems, and documented deployments.

Through them, I practice writing maintainable code, structuring applications properly, improving user experience, and learning by building real features from end to end.

I provided remote technical support for CCTV, networking, and access control systems. I helped diagnose issues, assisted clients by phone, worked with remote-access tools such as TeamViewer, and supported equipment setup and troubleshooting as part of a technical team.
